classes.description: WorkCenter — 工作中心。车间中执行制造操作的物理或逻辑区域，是组织生产活动和追踪在制品(WIP)的基本单位。配置派工方法(dispatchMethod)、队列时间(fastQueueTime/normalQueueTime)、派工规则(DispatchRule)、制造日历(MfgCalendar)、资源组(ResourceGroup)、培训要求组(TrainingRequirementGroup)、WIP消息管理器(WIPMsgDefMgr)和工作时间表(WorkSchedule)。 【Swagger】Schema: WorkCenterEntity；来源文件: WorkCenters.json；API: /api/WorkCenters。

properties.name: setupAccess
properties.description: 关联的建模访问权限（A_SetupAccess）。 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: mfgCalendar
properties.description: 制造日历 → MfgCalendar 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: resourceGroup
properties.description: 默认资源组 → ResourceGroup 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: wipMsgDefMgr
properties.description: WIP消息定义管理器 → WIPMsgDefMgr 【Swagger】引用 Schema: WIPMsgEntity。

properties.name: dispatchMethod
properties.description: 派工方法：1=Dispatch Queue Only(仅队列), 2=Dynamic Only(仅动态), 3=Both(队列+动态) 【Swagger】Determines the method for dispatching in this Work Center: 1 = Dispatch Queue Only 2 = Dynamic Only 3 = Dispatch Queue and Dynamic Dynamic dispatching means listing all applicable containers within the Work Center

properties.name: name
properties.description: 工作中心名称（必填） 【Swagger】Unique name for this instance

properties.name: description
properties.description: 描述说明 【Swagger】Description of this entity. Defaults to the name of this entity if not specified

properties.name: iconId
properties.description: 关联的图标标识 【Swagger】Identifier for the icon associated with this Base Entity

properties.name: isFrozen
properties.description: 是否已冻结（只读） 【Swagger】Determines if changes are allowed to this instance (or any of its revisions)

properties.name: normalQueueTime
properties.description: 正常队列时间（小时），处理前在此工作中心等待的典型时间 【Swagger】The length of time (in hours) that work will typically wait at this Work Center before processing begins

properties.name: workSchedule
properties.description: 工作时间表/排班 → WorkSchedule 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: fastQueueTime
properties.description: 快速队列时间（小时），处理前在此工作中心等待的最短时间 【Swagger】The minimum length of time (in hours) that work will wait at this Work Center before processing begins

properties.name: trainingReqGroup
properties.description: 培训要求组 → TrainingRequirementGroup 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: notes
properties.description: 备注说明 【Swagger】Notations and comments associated with this object.

properties.name: dispatchRule
properties.description: 派工规则 → DispatchRule 【Swagger】引用 Schema: NamedObjectRef。

properties.name: filterTags
properties.description: 分类筛选标签 【Swagger】FilterTags comma seperated list
